question: By what means is the offering seen, looked upon and sprinkled in this rite?
premises: The offering is seen and looked upon by means of an offering of the eye kindled by rays.
It is sprinkled, and only so.
That sprinkling is indeed done by drops from an argha vessel.
inference: The offering is seen and looked upon by an offering of the eye kindled by rays, and it is sprinkled only by drops from an argha vessel.
uncertainties: Exact function of the eye offering is not explained by this verse alone.
Relation between seeing and sprinkling remains sequential rather than explicit.
plain_english: The offering is seen and looked upon by an offering of the eye kindled by rays, and it is sprinkled only with drops from an argha vessel.
